project_name: Connectify Club - Editorial Atelier Pastel Mobile & Asset Art Direction
archetype: ORGANIC & PASTEL ATELIER (Warm, tactile, playful, high-contrast readability)

art_direction_blueprint.style_rules: Vector-style high-definition 3D pastel assets with subtle ink outline, warm ambient occlusions, soft clay/felt texture, no generic AI gradients. Must fit seamlessly on light cream background (#fffaf5).

theme_sheets_4x4.description: Japanese Zen Blossom & Tea Garden theme
theme_sheets_4x4.prompt: 4x4 grid sheet of 16 distinct Japanese Sakura & Tea Garden icons, soft pastel ink-and-wash vector 3D render, cherry blossom, dango, matcha whisk, geta, origami crane, bonsai, lantern, torii gate, fan, koi fish, omikuji, teapot, mochi, zen stones, bell, isometric 3D claymation aesthetic, isolated on transparent background, clean outlines, high detail.

4x4 grid sheet of 16 artisan bakery icons, soft pastel pastel 3D food illustration, croissant, shortcake, macarons, cinnamon roll, baguette, pretzel, whisk, rolling pin, cupcake, tart, donut, espresso, butter, jam jar, eclair, chef hat, cozy warm lighting, matte clay finish, isolated on white/transparent background.

4x4 grid sheet of 16 cosmic starlight icons, dreamy pastel midnight galaxy vector art, crescent moon, star crystal, saturn, comet, cute astronaut helmet, rocket, nebula, meteor, space station, cosmic portal, stardust bottle, glowing pastel indigo and lavender tones, isolated on dark violet background.

4x4 grid sheet of 16 meadow botanical wildlife icons, warm pastel nature illustration, chamomile, honeybee, ladybug, mushroom, oak leaf, acorn, snail, clover, watering can, butterfly, robin bird, pinecone, dew drop, sunflower, spade, nest, soft mossy greens and warm earth tones, isolated background.

4x4 grid sheet of 16 fresh fruit orchard icons, vibrant soft pastel 3D vector icons, strawberry, lemon, peach, watermelon, blueberry, avocado, cherries, pineapple, kiwi, banana, grape, orange, dragonfruit, mangosteen, apple, pear, clean glossy-matte finish, isolated background.

tile_skins_sheet.description: Empty physical tile surfaces, bevels, frames, win effect particle sprites
tile_skins_sheet.prompt: Grid sheet of 12 empty physical tile base surfaces and frames, square rounded tiles with 3D tactile bevels, clay texture, wooden grain, translucent jelly glass, ceramic glaze, pastel starlight, blank centered surface for icons, isolated on transparent canvas.

avatars_and_frames.prompt: Grid sheet of 8 cute pastel animal avatar portraits in circular badges, bear, cat, panda, bunny, shiba, fox, penguin, koala, wearing cute hats/accessories, warm friendly editorial art style, pastel background badges.

brand_and_logo.prompt: Connectify Club game emblem logo, interlocking pastel puzzle & tile connect motif, 3D clay vector style, warm cream background, 'Connectify Club' typography in bold rounded font.

colors.contrast_ratio_min: 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large headers and buttons

visual_enhancers.card_style: 2px solid #172337 ink border, 3px offset box-shadow (shadow-[3px_3px_0px_#172337]), rounded-2xl

grids_and_layouts.mobile_container: max-w-[480px] mx-auto px-4 pb-20 pt-4 min-h-screen

motion.tile_connection_animation: 2x2 splits into horizontal/vertical dominoes, then 1x1 children, with themed particle bursts

accessibility.test_id: All interactive buttons, tiles, cards, navigation links must have data-testid in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid='onet-tile-1', data-testid='shop-skin-wood-buy')
accessibility.contrast: APCA compliant text contrast against pastel backgrounds

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use Canvas 2D sprites or CSS3D for tile animations; R3F only for celebratory 3D particle bursts

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all .js and .jsx files reference the 5 pastel theme icon sets (Sakura, Bakery, Midnight Galaxy, Meadow, Fruit) as core selection options.

Keep all 15 vanilla matching tiles in the initial free Summer Club theme. Preserve prior generated Sakura/Bakery/Galaxy/Meadow/Fruit assets as separate reward editions. New bitmap assets live at /art/premium/; no in-app generator.
Tile skins must act as background/surface/frame textures behind match icons.
Apply kebab-case data-testid attributes to all buttons, tabs, input fields, modal dialogs, and game board tiles.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attribute: MUST add data-testid to every interactive component (e.g., data-testid='play-onet-button')
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Do not center everything, do not use boring single-weight Inter for headings. Keep tactile ink borders and distinct pastel contrast.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Headers, menus, and modals must have non-transparent frosted glass or solid pastel backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain 2-3x generous spacing in menus and modal dialogs for high touch usability.
